title: Docker patches a host-filesystem escape affecting agent sandboxes on Mac
friendlyTitle: Update Docker before using it as a safety box for coding agents
summary: Security researchers disclosed CVE-2026-77179, a path-handling flaw that let a container gain read and write access outside its mounted folder when Docker VMM was enabled. Docker fixed it in Desktop 4.88.0 and Sandboxes 0.42.0.
friendlySummary: A Docker bug on Mac could let code inside a container read or change files elsewhere on the computer. The fix is in Docker Desktop 4.88.0 and Docker Sandboxes 0.42.0.
whyItMatters: Coding agents routinely execute untrusted commands, so their sandbox is a security control rather than a convenience. Mac users running agents through Docker should confirm those minimum versions and avoid assuming that a container alone protects host credentials and files.
friendlyWhyItMatters: AI coding tools run commands that may be unsafe. An old Docker version may not keep those commands away from your private files.
